description: This file contains utility functions for managing language directories, language packs, dropdown lists, and string replacements in the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions to create language directories, generate and modify language files, manage dropdown list options, and handle cache clearing.

methods.name: create_include_lang_dir
methods.description: Creates the language directory in custom/include/language if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_module_lang_dir
methods.description: Creates the language directory inside a specific module under custom/modules, if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_field_lang_pak_contents
methods.description: Generates the PHP contents for a language file with a specific key-value pair, possibly replacing existing content.

methods.name: create_dropdown_lang_pak_contents
methods.description: Generates the PHP contents for a language dropdown list array.

methods.name: create_field_label_all_lang
methods.description: Creates a language label in all supported languages.

methods.name: create_field_label
methods.description: Creates or updates a language label in a specific language file for a module.

methods.name: create_dropdown_type_all_lang
methods.description: Creates a dropdown list type in all supported languages.

methods.name: save_custom_app_list_strings_contents
methods.description: Saves the given language array to a file in the custom/include/language directory.

methods.name: save_custom_app_list_strings
methods.description: Saves an array of dropdown options to a language file.

methods.name: return_custom_app_list_strings_file_contents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of a custom language file.

methods.name: create_dropdown_type
methods.description: Creates a new dropdown list key in the language files.

methods.name: create_dropdown_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown menu based on key-value pairs.

methods.name: dropdown_item_delete
methods.description: Deletes an item from a dropdown list in the language files.

methods.name: helper_dropdown_item_delete
methods.description: Helper function to remove an element at a specific index from a dropdown array.

methods.name: dropdown_item_move_up
methods.description: Moves an item up in the dropdown list.

methods.name: dropdown_item_move_down
methods.description: Moves an item down in the dropdown list.

methods.name: dropdown_item_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new item into a dropdown list at a specific position.

methods.name: helper_dropdown_item_insert
methods.description: Helper to insert a key-value pair into an array at a specific index.

methods.name: dropdown_item_edit
methods.description: Edits an existing item in a dropdown list.

methods.name: replace_or_add_dropdown_type
methods.description: Replaces or adds a dropdown list in the language file content.

methods.name: replace_or_add_app_string
methods.description: Replaces or adds a string in a language file's PHP content.

methods.name: dropdown_duplicate_check
methods.description: Checks for duplicate dropdown entries and consolidates them.

methods.name: replace_dropdown_type
methods.description: Replaces the PHP code for a specific dropdown list in language content.

methods.name: replace_app_string
methods.description: Replaces a specific string in PHP language content.

methods.name: app_string_duplicate_check
methods.description: Checks for duplicate string definitions and consolidates them.
